title: Set timezone and enable network time sync
summary: Configure your Mac's timezone and enable automatic time synchronization with a network server. This ensures your clock stays accurate.

steps.explain: Set the timezone, specify an NTP server, and enable network time synchronization.

placeholders.name: TIMEZONE
placeholders.description: The timezone identifier, e.g., US/Pacific, Europe/Moscow

placeholders.name: NTP_SERVER
placeholders.description: The address of the NTP server

rollback.explain: Disable network time synchronization if you want to set the time manually.

warnings: Incorrect timezone settings can cause issues with scheduled tasks and logs.
